title: Model Makers, Wood
description: Construct full-size and scale wooden precision models of products. Includes wood jig builders and loft workers.

tasks.text: Read blueprints, drawings, or written specifications, and consult with designers to determine sizes and shapes of patterns and required machine setups.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprint setup reading partial, human confirms

dwas.name: Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.
Exchange information with colleagues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Fit, fasten, and assemble wood parts together to form patterns, models, or sections, using glue, nails, dowels, bolts, screws, and other fasteners.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Wood assembly requires hands-on fitting and fastening

tasks.text: Verify dimensions and contours of models during hand-forming processes, using templates and measuring devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Trim, smooth, and shape surfaces, and plane, shave, file, scrape, and sand models to attain specified shapes, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Shape surfaces or edges of wood workpieces.

tasks.text: Plan, lay out, and draw outlines of units, sectional patterns, or full-scale mock-ups of products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Construct wooden models, patterns, templates, full scale mock-ups, and molds for parts of products and production tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mold building is hands-on craft work

tasks.text: Select wooden stock, determine layouts, and mark layouts of parts on stock, using precision equipment such as scribers, squares, and protractors.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Mark identifying information on patterns, parts, and templates to indicate assembly methods and details.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Set up, operate, and adjust a variety of woodworking machines such as bandsaws and planers to cut and shape sections, parts, and patterns, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Build jigs that can be used as guides for assembling oversized or special types of box shooks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Machine tool assembly is skilled manual work

dwas.name: Assemble machine tools, parts, or fixtures.

tasks.text: Issue patterns to designated machine operators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically delivering supplies to workers

tasks.text: Fabricate work aids such as scrapers or templates.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical construction of templates and work aids

dwas.name: Construct patterns, templates, or other work aids.

tasks.text: Finish patterns or models with protective or decorative coatings such as shellac, lacquer, or wax.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.
